March 14, 2024 - V.A.N.S. (Vault-Tec Assisted Navigational System) is an Intelligence perk in Fallout 4. Taking rank 1 of this perk grants the ability to generate a pathfinding tool, represented as an opaque line, when using V.A.T.S. that directs the player character along the shortest path to a quest or destination marker.[1] Rank 2, which was added to the game with the Nuka-World add-on, grants a permanent boost of +2 to Perception.
